title.narrative: Improving the resilience of the health system in Mali - Mali (01-Jan-2021-31-Dec-2023)

description.narrative: Mali, RSSH, Ministry of Health and Social Development of the Republic of Mali (MOH Mali)This program has the following goals: SRPS : Contribuer à l'amélioration de l'état de santé et du bien-être de la population malienne / RSSH: Contribute to improving the health and well-being of the Malian population. The objectives of this program are: Améliorer les capacités de surveillance, en particulier celles à base communautaire, celles de laboratoire pour la décentralisation du diagnostic, l’autonomisation progressive notamment en matière de séquençage / Improve surveillance capacities, in particular community-based surveillance, laboratory capacities for decentralized diagnosis, and gradual autonomy, particularly in sequencing. Répondre aux besoins en oxygène dans le pays / Meet the country's oxygen needs. Améliorer le système de rapportage et d’alerte au travers des outils électroniques pour garantir une réponse rapide et fondée sur une information précise et fiable / Improve the reporting and alert system using electronic tools to guarantee a rapid response based on accurate and reliable information. Renforcer le système de préparation et de riposte aux épidémies à travers le renforcement de capacités, en complément des efforts fournis par le pays et les différents PTF autour du Plan Stratégique de Sécurité Sanitaire / Strengthen the epidemic preparedness and response system through capacity-building, complementing the efforts made by the country and the various technical and financial partners around the Strategic Health Security Plan

Outcome indicators targets and results for MLI-S-MOHP01

HSS O-Other 3 Percentage of people living with HIV not on ART at the end of the reporting period among people living with HIV who were either on ART at the end of the last reporting period or newly initiated on ART during the reporting period

HSS O-Other 1 TB treatment coverage: Percentage of new and relapse cases that were notified and treated among the estimated number of incident TB cases in the same year (all forms of TB - bacteriologically confirmed plus clinically diagnosed)

National aggregate HMIS fully deployed and functional: Percentage of HMIS components in place (HIS deployment, completeness, timeliness, and integration of aggregate disease reporting for HIV, TB and malaria indicators)
HSS O-Other 4 Percentage of people living with HIV and on ART who are virologically suppressed

HSS O-Other 2 Treatment success rate- all forms: Percentage of all forms of TB cases (bacteriologically confirmed plus clinically diagnosed) successfully treated (cured plus treatment completed) among all forms of TB cases registered for treatment during a specified period
